summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus private _resolve_path helper, stdlib json/os only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst under Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Nothing was run or committed. Line lengths were checked with awk (none over 120) and trailing whitespace with grep; black and flake8 were not run. Choices beyond the spec: non-list values under the data list key raise ValueError, JSON decode errors are re-raised as ValueError naming the file, and items are copied rather than mutated.
